subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the pairing fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally review and own the broad unrelated current-head bundle?
rationale: The current head combines a valid P1 pairing repair with a dirty, security-sensitive, 350-file unrelated final commit; automation cannot safely infer whether maintainers want that bundle preserved or stripped.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the pairing repair, remove the unrelated current-head bundle, fix the parse-error fail-closed gap, and rerun focused plus changed-head proof.

options.title: Accept the bundle intentionally
options.body: Treat the i18n, workflow, Docker, dependency, app, provider, channel, and agent changes as intentional scope and require full owner/security review plus proof for those surfaces.

options.title: Replace or pause
options.body: If the dirty branch is not worth salvaging, open a clean replacement for the pairing fix and leave this PR paused until maintainers decide its fate.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the pairing repair, remove the unrelated current-head bundle, fix the parse-error fail-closed gap, and rerun focused plus changed-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the PR and authored the current broad head commit and pairing refinements.
